payload.reason: M2.5 Slice 2 is approved and the unit is authorized to transition to COMPLETED. The dedicated verification suite explicitly validates the workspace master shell, all five workspace tabs, the reported modal infrastructure, client-side bindings, all six M2.4 endpoint contracts, and all three print-report modes through the required report-layout shell. The tests also verify the statutory Seminar presentation metadata, 75-mark allocation, 67.5M academic plus 7.5M attendance split, grade distribution, and institutional print/signature content. Dedicated verification passes with 8 tests and 66 assertions; the M2.4 controller suite also remains green at 10 tests and 59 assertions; and the complete application suite passes at 55 tests and 416 assertions with zero failures or regressions. The implementation remains within the approved 15-file Blade architecture, with every Blade file below the 500-line ceiling and the reported global x-ui.* component reuse preserved. No unauthorized files, database changes, or User.php modifications were introduced. The architectural and safety acceptance criteria for M2.5 are therefore satisfied, and the unit may be checkpointed and committed.
